newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Metrobank seen planning U.S. dollar FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Metrobank seen planning U.S. dollar FRCD.

text.p: Metropolitan Bank and Trust Co is planning to issue a floating rate certificate of deposit issue, bankers said.
They said the issue size is expected to be between US$100 million and US$150 million. The facility has a final maturity of five years with no put or call options.
No formal mandate has been awarded yet, bankers said.
Pricing details are not available yet.
Last August, the issuer paid an all-in return of 95 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate for a five-year floating rate certificate of deposit issue.
The issue size was increased to US$100 million from US$50 million due to oversubscription in syndication.
